name: Badtimes
Text: Play only if Runner is tagged. Runner's MU is reduced by 2 until end of turn.
Flavor: "They always think it's a hoax."

name: Baskerville
Text: @ Do 2 Net damage. @ Trace5– If trace is successful, give Runner a Baskerville counter. Each counter does 2 Net damage at the start of each run. Runner may remove a Baskerville counter by taking an action to spend [3]. @ End the run. If Runner has used a noisy icebreaker during this run, the cost to rez Baskerville is reduced by [5].

name: Bolter Swarm
Text: @ Do 4 Net damage. @ Runner cannot break any subroutines on the next piece of ice encountered during this run. If Runner has used a noisy icebreaker during this run, the cost to rez Bolter Swarm is reduced by [5].

name: Boostergang Connections
Text: Trash your hand. Search your stack for as many cards as were successfuly trashed in this way and bring them into your hand. Shuffle your stack afterward.
Flavor: "If you don't fear death, they're great to hang with."

name: Brain Drain
Text: @ Roll a die. On a 1, do 3 brain damage.
Flavor: "Weefs never look 'up.'" -Edger

name: Corporate Shuffle
Text: Draw five cards, then shuffle a card stored in HQ into R&D. (Playing a double operation costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.)
Flavor: "It's a shell game for the shareholders."

name: Corruption
Text: Play only if you scored any agendas this turn. Lose all agenda points you scored this turn, and the Corp scores that many agenda points. Gain [10] per agenda point lost in this way, and the Corp gives you a tag.
Flavor: "Excuse me, Dave? Can I borrow 250,000 eb 'til payday?"

name: Crash Space
Text: Gain [1] at the start of each of your turns. All trace attempts are automatically successful, and give you a tag in addition to their other effects. If Crash Space leaves play lose [2]. [A] Trash Crash Space.

name: Data Fort Remapping
Text: Put a Remap counter on Data Fort Remapping when you score it. Remap Counter: End a run.
Flavor: "In netspace, the map is often the territory. That's just one more reason we don't hire philosopy grads." -Dave Michaels

name: Deadeye
Text: @ Trash a program. @ End the run. If Runner has used a noisy icebreaker during this run, the cost to rez Deadeye is reduced by [5].
Flavor: Wakes up shooting at the drop of a hat

name: Do the 'Drine™
Text: Suffer any amount of brain damage, but not enough to flatline you or to reduce your hand size to less than 0. Gain [4] for each point of brain damage you suffer in this way. This damage cannot be prevented.
Flavor: "I may be stupid, but I'm rich!"

name: Dumpster
Text: Dumpster cannot be installed on the Archives. @ Runner is now encountering the outermost piece of rezzed ice on the Archives, instead of passing Dumpster. The run is now considered to be a run on the Archives. If there is no rezzed ice on the Archives, Runner is considered to have passed the last piece of ice on the Archives.

name: Early Worm
Text: [1]: Break wall subroutine. [2]: +3 strength
Flavor: "The Early Worm gets the bird ... from corporate sysops." -AI Boone

name: Elena Laskova
Text: Whenever you play a prep, gain an additional [1] the first time you gain bits from its effet.
Flavor: "... But somehow you never go away thinking you got the best of the deal."

name: Entrapment
Text: @ If you pay [2], Runner is now encountering the outermost piece of rezzed ice on a data fort of your choice, instead of passing Entrapment. The run is now considered to be a run on that data fort. If there is no rezzed ice on that fort, Runner is considered to have passed the last piece of ice on that fort.

name: Executive File Clerk
Text: [2],[T]: Look at all cards stored in HQ.
Flavor: "I only signed a noncompete agreement; it didn't say anything about nondisclosure."

name: Finders Keepers
Text: Roll three dice. Gain that many bits.
Flavor: "Looks like both our luck's changed."

name: Glacier
Text: Rezzing Glacier cost 1 agenda point, in addition to the normal cost. @ End the run. @ End the run. [1]: Move Glacier to the outermost position of any other data fort. Use this ability only at the start of a run. You may use this ability even if Glacier is unrezzed, in which case, you reveal it.

name: Gypsy™ Schedule Analyzer
Text: Make a run on R&D. If run is successful, do not access any cards. Instead, reveal cards one at a time from R&D until you reveal an agenda card or there are no cards left in R&D. Store the agenda, if any, in HQ and shuffle the other revealed cards, if any, into R&D.

name: Imperial Guard
Text: @ Trash a program. @ End the run. If Runner has used a noisy icebreaker during this run, the cost to rez Imperial Guard is reduced by [5].

name: Indiscriminate Response Team
Text: After Runner makes a successful run, you may have Runner shuffle his or her hand into his or her stack and then draw as many cards as he or she had before.
Flavor: "But did you get him?"

name: Library Search
Text: Make a run on R&D or HQ. If run is successful, access two additional cards if you used no noisy icebreakers during the run and if no trace attempts were made during the run.

name: Little Black Box
Text: Provides +1 MU and +1 hand size. Prevent up to 1 Net or brain damage each turn. Put [1] from the bank on Little Black Box when it is installed. Use this bit only to pay for increasing your link. If you use the bit, replace it from the bank at the start of your next turn.

name: London City Grid
Text: Runner must pay [1], in addition to the normal cost, to use each subroutine of a noisy icebreaker during runs on this fort.
Flavor: London: home to Big Ben, Buckingham Palace, and some of the nastiest, most insidious, and downright brilliant code this side of the Pond.

name: Matador
Text: [1]: Break sentry subroutine. [3]: +5 strength
Flavor: This little fella really cuts through the bull.

name: Meat Upgrade
Text: Remove up to two tags, at no cost, and draw three cards. (Playing a double prep costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.)
Flavor: They can make you gorgeous cheap, but to make you plain costs extra.

name: MS-todon
Text: [1]: Break sentry subroutine. [1]: +1 strength. The first time during each run that you break a sentry subroutine with MS-todon, lose all bits from all stealth cards, if you can, and the Corp gives you a tag.
Flavor: This isn't running - it's stomping.

name: Networking
Text: Gain [9]. (Playing a double prep costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.)
Flavor: "It's not what you know or even who; it's how often."

name: Omnitech "Spinal Tap" Cybermodem
Text: Provides +1 Mu. Put [2] from the bank on Omnitech "Spinal Tap" Cybermodem when it is installed. Use this bits only to pay for using icebreakers during runs or increasing your link. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn.  At the start of each of your turns roll a die. On a 1, suffer 2 brain damage. This damage cannot be prevented.  If Omnitech "Spinal Tap" Cyermodem leaves play suffer 2 brain damage.

name: Omnitech Wet Drive
Text: Your base MU is equal to the number of cards in your hand instead of 4.
Flavor: "Now with reduced long-term memory loss!" - Rejected marketing slogan

name: Panzer Run
Text: Gain [4] and draw two cards.
Flavor: "So I just drive a truck from Point A to Point B? How hard can that be?"

name: Psychic Friend
Text: [1]: Break code gate subroutine. [2]: +1 strength until end of turn
Flavor: "Call now for ten nanoseconds of icebreaking absolutely free! (10 eb each subsequent ns.)"

name: Puzzle
Text: @ End the run, and trash Puzzle at end of turn. @ End the run, and trash Puzzle at end of turn.

name: Reclamation Project
Text: Search the archives for any number of ice cards. Show those cards to Runner, then store them in HQ. (Playing a double operation costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.)
Flavor: "The code's already there; why let it go to waste?"

name: Rent-I-Con
Text: [1]: Break ice subroutine. At the end of this run, trash Rent-I-Con. [1]: +1 strength.
Flavor: It's big and mean and lasts about sixteen microseconds.

name: Running Interference
Text: Make a run. During that run, the Corp must pay [X], in addition to the normal cost, to rez each piece of ice, where X is the rez cost of that piece of ice.
Flavor: "Look! A distraction!"

name: Sandbox Dig
Text: [3], [T]: Look at the top three cards stored in R&D.
Flavor: "As long as the drones keep griping online, I'm in business."

name: Satellite Monitors
Text: At the start of each of your turns, you may roll a die for each run Runner made during his or her last turn. For each 1, give Runner a tag.
Flavor: "Say, isn't that your daughter?"

name: Schematics Search Engine
Text: Whenever you access cards from HQ, expose all of the Corp's installed cards.
Flavor: "Not only is the map the terrain - somtimes you can only get places by folding the map." -Edger

name: Self-Destruct
Text: Install Self-Destruct only in a subsidiary data fort. [T] Trash all other cards installed in or on this data fort. Do 1 Net damage for each card successfully trashed in this way. Use this ability only when Runner accesses Self-Destruct.
Flavor: "This'll ream our bottom line unless we reclassify data-entry clerks as 'consumables.'"

name: Shock Treatment
Text: When Runner accesses Shock Treatment, trash all pieces of hardware and two programs. Ignore this effect unless Runner has four or more tags.
Flavor: "Yo, Bob, red light. Bob? Red Light! Bob, c'mon - I'm serious! GAH! Now there's a fire and a red light! Bob?"

name: Sterdroid
Text: [3], [T]: Choose a piece of ice. That ice's strength is doubled until end of turn. If this would raise the ice's strength above 10, ist strength becomes 10.
Flavor: "Runners love this one like bikers adore wires across roads." -Norman Niemann, WuTech security director

name: Strategic Planning Group
Text: Whenever you draw one or more cards, draw an extra card. Then place one of the drawn cards on the bottom of R&D.
Flavor: "We don't plot; we faciliate."

name: Street Enforcer
Text: At the start of each run on this data fort, Runner loses [X], where X is equal to the number of tags Runner has.
Flavor: "I think you know why I'm here."

name: Superglue
Text: [T]: Derez a piece of ice. Use this ability only if you have just broken all the subroutines of that piece of ice.
Flavor: "Epoxy both your houses!" -Bard

name: Superserum
Text: When you score Superserum, remove all Virus counters, and avoid receiving the next two Virus counters Runner gives to you.
Flavor: "A holisitc approach to system immunology: its AI routines mark both computer viruses and suspect moles for deletion."

name: Theorem Proof
Text: If Runner accesses Theorem Proof, he or she does not score it, but instead may install it as a 2 MU program that has the ability "[A]: Score Theorem Proof" but is removed from the game if it leaves play in any other way.

name: Trapdoor
Text: Install Trapdoor only on R&D or HQ. @ Runner is now encountering the outermost piece of rezzed ice on a subsidiary data fort of your choice, instead of passing Trapdoor. The run is now considered to be a run on that data fort. If there is no rezzed ice on that fort, Runner is considered to have passed the last piece of ice on that fort. Runner automatically breaks this subroutine if there are no subsidiary data forts.

name: Unlisted Research Lab
Text: Draw an additional card at the start of each of your turns.
Flavor: "You may feel some discomfort."

name: Vintage Camaro
Text: [1], Forgo your next action: Avoid receiving a tag.
Flavor: "I'm not firing a LAW at that! It's a classic!"

name: Vortex
Text: @ If you pay [2], Runner is now encountering the outermost piece of rezzed ice on a data fort of your choice, instead of passing Vortex. The run is now considered to be a run on that data fort. If there is no rezzed ice on that fort, Runner is considered to have passed the last piece of ice on that fort.

name: Zetatech Portastation
Text: Put [1] from the bank on Zetatech Portostation when it is installed. Use this bit only to pay for playing preps. If you use the bit, replace it from the bank at the start of your next turn.
Flavor: "Zetatech. All you need is a brain, a deck, and a afriend." - Short-lived WNS ad campaign
